notes.title: Post Launch Update 2 - Bug fixes, balances, and save fixing
notes.notes:
More playtime means more bugs! Shoutout to ChetMclovin for helping me spot a lot of these bugs. 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] - Added temporary keyboard support (mappings listed in settings)
[*] - Fixed a bug that allowed hilopets and enemies to continue fighting after they die
[*] - Fixed a bug that reset player stats after relaunching the game
[*] - Changed the prices in the shop
[*] - Balanced stat generation and stat gains to make for a more incremental experience
[*] - Minor tweaks and fixes
[/list]

Have any bugs or suggestions? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/mXUsmcPbj4]discord![/url]

notes.title: My Personal Hilopet Release Date
notes.notes:
[h1]My Personal Hilopet releases March 11th, 2022![/h1]
Hey everyone! Just wanted to give you all an update regarding the release of the game. Hilopet is slated for mid March. The game is complete, and all features are implemented, but we're waiting that long to allow for extra dialogue to be written so that the game on launch is as robust as possible! We're aiming for over 600 unique dialogue lines based on location, season, and character. Easter eggs and hidden character interactions abound! Like the main game, the dialogue system will be simplified to fit the aesthetic we're working toward, but I think you'll be happy with the final product!

As well, saves have been fully implemented, including a hall of fame that keeps track of your old pets! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820721/c39b12c75310a9687621648806d7d92d06c94faa.png[/img]

And of course we got the casino in as well ~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40820721/bc29551bb42c521200be4cb9a96d4e2309b210b4.png[/img]

I'll be updating the store's graphics to match, and will be working on shaping up the image of the game before launch! If you'd like to engage with the community before launch, join [url=https://discord.gg/mSF7BUkKRb]my discord![/url]

notes.title: The 5 Months Too Late Update
notes.notes:
Hello! It's been a while! And WOW I'm late aren't I.

Just wanted to give you guys an update regarding the game, and to showcase some of the cool features that are en route to hilopet!

First, I'm incredibly sorry about the delays, and the lack of updates regarding the delays. My computer was wiped, and I had to reorient myself to the game and code once I finally got it back on my main desktop. That, coupled with feature creep and my full-time job left me fairly occupied and constantly pushing the game off. But things have been put back under control, and I'd argue I'm within a week of having a completed version of the game :D

And to showcase that, I've included some images of the new locations and the new UI! The save icon and calendar are self explanatory, but the star will now hold the Hall of Fame! All previous pets and their lives will be mentioned here. I've also moved the sound icon to be within a settings menu, rather than fixed in the bottom lefthand corner of the screen. The dojo shown will also allow you to change the special ability of your pet after you get a few tournament wins. 

So what's left?
[list]
[*] Balancing
[*] Implementing visiting for random encounters
[*] General save debugging
[*] Steam integration!
[/list]

And then We should be set >:)
